<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">
<title>PolicyWatcher Live Dev Diary | Episode 001</title>
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<script>document.documentElement.classList.add('js');</script>
<style>
:root {
  color-scheme:dark;
  --ink:#f6f8ff;
  --slate:#0f172a;
  --deep:#050818;
  --panel:#10172d;
  --muted:#b8c3dc;
  --subtle:#94a5c1;
  --line:#313c58;
  --indigo:#6366f1;
  --cyan:#06b6d4;
  --bright:#79e6f6;
  --light-indigo:#b8b7ff;
  --amber:#ffda98;
  --mono:"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
  --display:"Avenir Next","Segoe UI",sans-serif;
}
* { box-sizing:border-box; }
html { background:var(--deep); }
body { margin:0; min-width:0; color:var(--ink); font-family:var(--display); }
button,a { -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent; }
button { font:inherit; color:inherit; }
button:not(:disabled) { cursor:pointer; }
a { color:inherit; text-underline-offset:4px; }
:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--bright); outline-offset:5px; }
[hidden] { display:none !important; }
.slide [tabindex="-1"]:focus { outline:none; }
h1,h2,h3,p,ol,ul,figure { margin:0; }
button:disabled { opacity:.36; cursor:default; }
code,time,.mono { font-family:var(--mono); }
.shell { min-height:100vh; min-height:100dvh; display:grid; grid-template-rows:auto 1fr auto; align-items:center; }
.bar { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:16px; width:min(100%,1440px); padding:12px 28px; margin:auto; }
.head { min-height:63px; }
.head-brand { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; font-size:15px; letter-spacing:.015em; font-weight:650; text-decoration:none; white-space:nowrap; }
.head-brand img { width:35px; height:35px; object-fit:contain; }
.head-tools { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; }
.tool { display:inline-flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; gap:7px; min-height:36px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:4px; background:#0c1226; padding:5px 12px; color:#dfe7fc; font-weight:550; font-size:13px; }
.tool:hover:not(:disabled) { background:#202948; border-color:var(--light-indigo); }
.icon { width:15px; height:15px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.7; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; }
.deck {
  width:min(calc(100% - 56px),calc((100dvh - 128px) * 16 / 9),1392px);
  margin-inline:auto;
  container-type:inline-size;
}
.slide {
  width:100%; aspect-ratio:16/9; position:relative; isolation:isolate;
  padding:4.5cqw 5.3cqw 4.1cqw;
  border:1px solid #303955; overflow:hidden; background:#0b1225;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; align-items:stretch; gap:1.8cqw;
}
.slide::before {
  content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:-2;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 100% 100%,#142047 0,transparent 54%),linear-gradient(137deg,#121a33 0%,#0b1125 52%,#0b1527 100%);
}
.slide::after { content:""; position:absolute; z-index:-1; inset:auto 5.3cqw 2.6cqw; height:1px; background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--line) 18%,var(--line) 82%,transparent); opacity:.55; }
html:not(.js) .slide + .slide { margin-top:24px; }
html:not(.js) .head-tools, html:not(.js) .foot { display:none; }
.js .slide:not(.is-current) { display:none; }
.kicker { color:var(--bright); font:650 clamp(10px,1.05cqw,16px)/1.25 var(--mono); letter-spacing:.135em; text-transform:uppercase; }
.slide h1,.slide h2,.slide h3 { letter-spacing:-.045em; }
.slide h1 { font-size:clamp(42px,7.4cqw,107px); line-height:.98; font-weight:750; }
.slide h2 { font-size:clamp(30px,4.8cqw,73px); line-height:1.02; font-weight:740; max-width:100%; }
.slide h3 { font-size:clamp(22px,2.4cqw,37px); line-height:1.1; font-weight:680; }
.slide p,.slide li { font-size:clamp(14px,1.78cqw,25px); line-height:1.36; }
.slide .small { font-size:clamp(12px,1.25cqw,18px); line-height:1.44; }
.slide .fine { font-size:clamp(11px,1.16cqw,17px); color:var(--subtle); line-height:1.44; }
.slide .mono { font-size:clamp(11px,1.16cqw,17px); }
.slide strong { color:var(--ink); font-weight:700; }
.slide .muted { color:var(--muted); }
.tint { color:var(--bright); }
.lavender { color:var(--light-indigo); }
.amber { color:var(--amber); }
.slide .action {
  width:max-content; max-width:100%; min-height:40px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:9px;
  text-decoration:none; padding:.65em .95em; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid #4d5a91;
  color:var(--ink); background:#1a2352; font-size:clamp(13px,1.24cqw,18px); font-weight:650; line-height:1.3;
}
.slide .action:hover { border-color:var(--bright); background:#242e68; }
.slide .action.primary { background:#f0f2ff; color:#151a38; border-color:#f0f2ff; }
.slide .action.primary:hover { background:#cfd6ff; }
.link-out { display:inline-flex; gap:.35em; align-items:center; width:max-content; max-width:100%; color:var(--bright); font-size:clamp(13px,1.35cqw,20px); text-decoration:none; font-weight:650; }
.link-out:hover { text-decoration:underline; }
.hero { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,.65fr); gap:3.8cqw; align-items:center; padding-bottom:3.3cqw; }
.hero::before {
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 84% 34%,#282b65 0,transparent 43%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 94% 90%,#103c54 0,transparent 40%),linear-gradient(135deg,#101a33,#090e23 72%);
}
.hero::after { opacity:.7; }
.hero-main { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start; gap:1.4cqw; }
.hero-brand { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.8cqw; font-size:clamp(13px,1.65cqw,24px); font-weight:650; margin-bottom:.55cqw; }
.hero-brand img { width:4.5cqw; height:4.5cqw; object-fit:contain; }
.hero h1 { font-size:clamp(44px,7.35cqw,105px); }
.hero h1 span { display:block; color:#b9c4ff; }
.episode-meta { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:.45em .65em; align-items:center; color:#99eafa; margin:.55rem 0 0; font:600 clamp(13px,1.28cqw,18px)/1.35 var(--mono); }
.episode-meta strong { color:#e1e6ff; }
.hero-main .lede { color:var(--muted); font-size:clamp(16px,2cqw,29px); }
.profile { position:relative; width:100%; min-width:0; display:grid; justify-items:start; }
.profile-field {
  aspect-ratio:1; width:100%; position:relative; isolation:isolate; display:grid; place-items:center;
  border:1px solid #6670b0; overflow:hidden; color:#a0aeed;
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0,transparent calc(12.5% - 1px),#9fb7f114 calc(12.5% - 1px),#9fb7f114 12.5%),repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0,transparent calc(12.5% - 1px),#9fb7f114 calc(12.5% - 1px),#9fb7f114 12.5%),radial-gradient(circle at 60% 45%,#253665,#101830 72%);
}
.profile-field::before { content:""; position:absolute; width:84%; height:84%; border:1px solid #8f9adb4d; border-radius:50%; inset:8%; z-index:-1; }
.profile-field::after { content:""; position:absolute; width:112%; height:1px; background:#b7bcff5c; z-index:-1; transform:rotate(-44deg); }
.portrait { margin:0; display:block; width:62%; max-width:250px; height:auto; aspect-ratio:1; object-fit:cover; object-position:50% 46%; border:1px solid #acc2fb; box-shadow:0 12px 42px #03081aa8; }
.crosshair { position:absolute; width:16px; height:16px; color:#b9cbff; }
.crosshair::before,.crosshair::after { content:""; position:absolute; background:currentColor; }
.crosshair::before { width:1px; height:100%; left:50%; }
.crosshair::after { height:1px; width:100%; top:50%; left:0; }
.crosshair.tl { top:7%; left:7%; }
.crosshair.br { bottom:7%; right:7%; }
.author { padding-top:1.2cqw; }
.author .name { font-size:clamp(24px,2.8cqw,41px); font-weight:700; line-height:1.15; letter-spacing:-.035em; }
.author .credentials { font-size:clamp(13px,1.3cqw,19px); color:var(--muted); line-height:1.45; }
.agenda { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(200px,.84fr) minmax(0,1.35fr); align-items:center; gap:5.6cqw; }
.agenda-copy { display:grid; gap:1.7cqw; }
.agenda h2 { font-size:clamp(42px,6.45cqw,96px); }
.agenda-list { list-style:none; padding:0; counter-reset:agendaitem; border-top:1px solid var(--line); }
.agenda-list li { counter-increment:agendaitem; display:grid; grid-template-columns:3.7cqw 1fr; gap:1.1cqw; align-items:baseline; padding:1.42cqw 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-size:clamp(17px,2.3cqw,34px); font-weight:620; line-height:1.15; }
.agenda-list li::before { content:"0" counter(agendaitem); color:var(--bright); font:500 clamp(11px,1.14cqw,17px)/1.3 var(--mono); letter-spacing:.04em; }
.split { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:3.8cqw; margin-top:.7cqw; }
.region { display:grid; align-content:start; align-items:start; gap:1.25cqw; padding:1.65cqw 0 0; border-top:2px solid #5a77ad; }
.region:nth-child(2) { border-color:#bc9666; }
.version { font-family:var(--mono); font-size:clamp(24px,4.4cqw,67px); letter-spacing:-.07em; line-height:1.04; font-weight:600; }
.region .kicker { color:var(--muted); letter-spacing:.055em; }
.region .status { font-weight:700; }
.region .action { margin-top:.2cqw; }
.notes-line { padding-top:1.12cqw; border-top:1px solid var(--line); display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:.75em 2.2cqw; flex-wrap:wrap; color:var(--muted); }
.flow {
  margin:.6cqw 0; display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(var(--steps,4),1fr);
  gap:1.9cqw; align-items:stretch; list-style:none; padding:0;
}
.flow li { min-width:0; position:relative; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:space-between; gap:.75cqw; padding:1.28cqw 1cqw 1.38cqw 0; border-top:2px solid var(--cyan); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); }
.flow li:nth-child(even) { border-top-color:#9998ff; }
.flow li:not(:last-child)::after { content:"→"; position:absolute; right:-1.3cqw; top:46%; color:#96baff; font:500 clamp(13px,1.3cqw,19px)/1 var(--mono); }
.flow .step-label { color:var(--subtle); font:500 clamp(11px,1.04cqw,16px)/1.22 var(--mono); }
.flow .step-name { font-size:clamp(19px,2.14cqw,32px); letter-spacing:-.035em; line-height:1.08; font-weight:700; }
.flow .step-detail { color:var(--muted); font-size:clamp(12px,1.43cqw,20px); line-height:1.3; }
.takeaway { max-width:100%; padding-left:1.15cqw; border-left:2px solid var(--cyan); color:#e1eaff; }
.inventory { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.1fr .85fr; gap:4.2cqw; align-items:start; }
.check-table { border-collapse:collapse; width:100%; table-layout:fixed; }
.check-table caption { color:var(--muted); text-align:left; font:500 clamp(10px,1cqw,14px)/1.3 var(--mono); margin-bottom:.7cqw; }
.check-table th,.check-table td { border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); padding:.68cqw .6cqw .68cqw 0; text-align:left; font-size:clamp(12px,1.38cqw,21px); line-height:1.2; }
.check-table th { color:var(--light-indigo); font-weight:650; }
.check-table td:not(:first-child),.check-table th:not(:first-child) { text-align:right; }
.check-table td:first-child,.check-table th:first-child { width:59%; }
.check-table tr.hold th,.check-table tr.hold td { color:var(--amber); }
.field-notes { display:grid; gap:1.24cqw; border-left:1px solid var(--line); padding-left:2.1cqw; }
.field-notes > p { font-size:clamp(13px,1.48cqw,21px); }
.chunk-demo { display:grid; gap:1.15cqw; --cell:#1d2750; }
.rebuild { display:grid; grid-template-columns:8.4cqw 1fr; align-items:center; gap:1.48cqw; padding:1.03cqw 0; border-top:1px solid var(--line); }
.rebuild:last-child { border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); }
.rebuild h3 { font:700 clamp(12px,1.27cqw,19px)/1.3 var(--mono); letter-spacing:.12em; color:var(--muted); }
.blocks { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.8cqw; }
.chunk { padding:.55cqw .85cqw; border:1px solid #5769ac; background:var(--cell); font:550 clamp(11px,1.34cqw,20px)/1.3 var(--mono); white-space:nowrap; }
.chunk.remove { color:#ffd8a7; border-color:#b08665; background:#32251d; }
.chunk.add { color:#b6f3fd; border-color:#529ba7; background:#12313e; }
.phases { list-style:none; padding:0; border-top:1px solid var(--line); }
.phases li { display:grid; grid-template-columns:14cqw 1fr; gap:1.75cqw; align-items:baseline; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); padding:.86cqw 0; }
.phases b { color:#a9d1ff; font-weight:650; font-size:clamp(15px,1.7cqw,24px); }
.phases p { font-size:clamp(13px,1.55cqw,22px); }
.phases code { font-size:.86em; color:var(--bright); }
.positioning { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr; gap:2.5cqw; border-top:1px solid var(--line); padding-top:1.55cqw; }
.positioning article { display:grid; align-content:start; gap:.7cqw; }
.positioning article + article { padding-left:1.65cqw; border-left:1px solid var(--line); }
.positioning h3 { font-size:clamp(20px,2.6cqw,40px); }
.positioning p { font-size:clamp(14px,1.6cqw,23px); }
.workbench::before {
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 9% 55%,#233169 0,transparent 40%),linear-gradient(120deg,#111631,#0b1225 50%,#101e34 92%);
}
.next-topic { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.08fr 1fr; align-items:center; gap:4cqw; }
.next-topic header { display:grid; gap:1cqw; align-content:center; }
.next-topic h2 { font-size:clamp(42px,6.45cqw,97px); max-width:9ch; }
.tracks { display:grid; border-top:1px solid var(--line); }
.tracks article { padding:1.2cqw 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); }
.tracks h3 { font-size:clamp(19px,2.15cqw,32px); margin-bottom:.3cqw; }
.tracks p { font-size:clamp(14px,1.37cqw,20px); color:var(--muted); }
.close {
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.1fr) minmax(0,.78fr); align-items:center; gap:5cqw;
}
.close::before { background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 75%,#183a58 0,transparent 54%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 65% 0,#2a2259 0,transparent 46%),linear-gradient(125deg,#0b1123,#111b36); }
.close-copy { display:grid; gap:1.2cqw; align-content:center; }
.close h2 { font-size:clamp(44px,6.65cqw,98px); }
.close .url { color:var(--bright); overflow-wrap:anywhere; }
.qr { justify-self:end; width:min(100%,29cqw); display:grid; gap:.6cqw; justify-items:center; }
.qr a { display:block; width:100%; background:#fff; text-decoration:none; padding:0; }
.qr img { display:block; width:100%; height:auto; aspect-ratio:1; }
.qr figcaption { color:var(--muted); font-size:clamp(12px,1.2cqw,18px); text-align:center; }
.progress { height:2px; position:absolute; inset:auto 0 0; background:#1b2341; }
.progress span { display:block; width:calc(var(--progress,0)*1%); height:100%; background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--indigo),var(--cyan)); transition:width .29s ease; }
.foot { position:relative; width:min(calc(100% - 56px),1392px); min-height:59px; padding:8px 0 10px; gap:12px; margin:0 auto; }
.slide-info { display:flex; min-width:0; align-items:center; gap:12px; }
.count { color:var(--bright); font:550 12px/1 var(--mono); white-space:nowrap; }
.active-title { color:var(--muted); overflow:hidden; white-space:nowrap; text-overflow:ellipsis; font-size:13px; }
.controls { display:flex; gap:8px; justify-content:flex-end; flex-shrink:0; }
.controls .tool { min-width:84px; }
.shortcut { color:var(--subtle); margin-left:auto; font:500 11px/1.24 var(--mono); white-space:nowrap; }
.overview { width:min(640px,calc(100vw - 28px)); max-height:92dvh; overflow:auto; color:var(--ink); background:#111930; padding:22px 26px 24px; border:1px solid #56638c; box-shadow:0 14px 64px #020513; }
.overview::backdrop { background:#020716c7; backdrop-filter:blur(6px); }
.overview-head { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:15px; margin-bottom:6px; }
.overview-head h2 { font-size:28px; letter-spacing:-.03em; }
.overview-list { margin:15px 0 0; padding:0; list-style:none; display:grid; }
.overview-list a { display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:12px; padding:10px 5px; border-top:1px solid var(--line); text-decoration:none; font-weight:600; }
.overview-list a::before { content:attr(data-number); color:var(--bright); font:500 12px/1 var(--mono); }
.overview-list a:hover,.overview-list a[aria-current="page"] { color:var(--bright); }
.sr-only { position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; padding:0; margin:-1px; overflow:hidden; clip-path:inset(50%); white-space:nowrap; }
@keyframes appear { from { opacity:0; transform:translateY(10px); } to { opacity:1; transform:translateY(0); } }
@keyframes catch { from { transform:rotate(-44deg) scaleX(.45); } to { transform:rotate(-44deg) scaleX(1); } }
@keyframes stretch { from { letter-spacing:-.09em; opacity:.3; } to { letter-spacing:-.07em; opacity:1; } }
.js .is-current > * { animation:appear .47s cubic-bezier(.21,.66,.23,1) both; }
.js .is-current > :nth-child(2) { animation-delay:.045s; }
.js .is-current > :nth-child(3) { animation-delay:.09s; }
.js .is-current > :nth-child(4) { animation-delay:.135s; }
.js .is-current .flow li { transform-origin:left; animation:appear .48s ease both; animation-delay:calc(var(--i,0) * .09s + .10s); }
.js .is-current .chunk { animation:appear .38s ease both; animation-delay:calc(var(--i,0) * .10s + .06s); }
.js .is-current .version { animation:stretch .46s .07s ease both; }
.js .is-current .profile-field::after { animation:catch .7s .13s ease both; transform:rotate(-44deg); }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {
  *,*::before,*::after { animation-duration:.001ms!important; animation-delay:0ms!important; scroll-behavior:auto!important; transition-duration:.001ms!important; }
}
@media (max-width:760px), (max-width:820px) and (orientation:portrait) {
  .shell { display:block; }
  .bar { width:100%; padding:9px 15px; gap:8px; }
  .head { min-height:55px; }
  .head-brand img { width:28px; height:28px; }
  .head-brand { font-size:14px; gap:6px; }
  .head-tools { gap:6px; }
  .tool { min-height:37px; padding:5px 9px; }
  .deck { width:calc(100% - 24px); }
  .slide { aspect-ratio:auto; min-height:calc(100svh - 111px); padding:24px 20px 25px; gap:18px; justify-content:flex-start; }
  .slide::after { display:none; }
  .hero,.agenda,.close,.next-topic { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr; align-items:start; align-content:start; gap:21px; }
  .hero-main,.agenda-copy,.close-copy,.next-topic header { display:grid; gap:11px; }
  .hero h1 { font-size:clamp(40px,10.8vw,70px); }
  .slide h2 { font-size:clamp(32px,8.1vw,53px); }
  .hero-brand img { width:38px; height:38px; }
  .hero-brand { gap:7px; }
  .profile { grid-template-columns:minmax(116px,.7fr) 1fr; align-items:center; gap:15px; }
  .profile-field { max-width:235px; }
  .author { padding:0; }
  .author .credentials { margin-top:4px; }
  .agenda-list li { grid-template-columns:28px 1fr; gap:9px; padding:13px 0; }
  .split { gap:17px; }
  .region { padding-top:12px; gap:9px; }
  .version { font-size:28px; }
  .notes-line { padding-top:10px; }
  .flow { grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:12px 15px; }
  .flow li { padding:9px 5px 10px 0; gap:6px; }
  .flow li:not(:last-child)::after { display:none; }
  .slide .flow .step-detail { font-size:13px; }
  .takeaway { padding-left:10px; }
  .inventory { grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:16px; }
  .check-table th,.check-table td { padding:8px 4px 8px 0; }
  .field-notes { gap:9px; padding-left:10px; }
  .rebuild,.phases li { grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:8px; padding:9px 0; }
  .blocks { flex-wrap:wrap; gap:5px; }
  .chunk { padding:6px; text-align:center; }
  .positioning { grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:10px; padding-top:10px; }
  .positioning article { gap:4px; }
  .positioning article + article { border-left:0; padding:9px 0 0; border-top:1px solid var(--line); }
  .tracks article { padding:10px 0; }
  .qr { width:min(250px,76%); justify-self:start; gap:6px; }
  .foot { position:sticky; z-index:4; bottom:0; background:#050818; min-height:51px; }
  .shortcut,.active-title { display:none; }
  .controls .tool { min-width:64px; }
}
@media (max-width:480px) {
  .split { grid-template-columns:1fr; }
}
@media (max-width:360px) {
  .slide { padding-inline:15px; }
  .head-brand .brand-label { display:none; }
  .profile { gap:10px; }
  .author .name { font-size:22px; }
}

<script>
(() => {
  "use strict";
  const slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("[data-slide]"));
  const deck = document.getElementById("deck");
  const overview = document.getElementById("overview");
  const overviewButton = document.getElementById("index-open");
  const count = document.getElementById("deck-count");
  const label = document.getElementById("deck-title");
  const prev = document.getElementById("prev");
  const next = document.getElementById("next");
  const fullscreen = document.getElementById("fullscreen");
  const footer = document.getElementById("deck-footer");
  const announce = document.getElementById("announcement");
  let current = -1;
  function readHash() {
    const requested = location.hash.slice(1);
    const index = slides.findIndex(slide => slide.dataset.slide === requested);
    return index < 0 ? 0 : index;
  }
  const titleOf = slide => slide.querySelector("h1,h2").textContent.trim().replace(/\s+/g," ");
  const links = slides.map(slide => {
    const item = document.createElement("li");
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = "#" + slide.dataset.slide;
    link.dataset.number = slide.dataset.slide;
    link.textContent = titleOf(slide);
    item.append(link);
    document.getElementById("overview-list").append(item);
    link.addEventListener("click", event => {
      if (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey || event.altKey || event.shiftKey) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      overview.close();
      go(slides.indexOf(slide), true);
    });
    return link;
  });
  function render(moveFocus = false) {
    const index = readHash();
    if (index === current && !moveFocus) return;
    const previous = current < 0 ? null : slides[current];
    const active = slides[index];
    const shouldFocus = moveFocus || previous?.contains(document.activeElement);
    for (const [i, slide] of slides.entries()) {
      slide.classList.toggle("is-current", i === index);
      if (i === index) {
        slide.removeAttribute("aria-hidden");
        links[i].setAttribute("aria-current","page");
      } else {
        slide.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true");
        links[i].removeAttribute("aria-current");
      }
    }
    current = index;
    count.value = active.dataset.slide + " / " + String(slides.length);
    label.textContent = titleOf(active);
    prev.disabled = index === 0;
    next.disabled = index === slides.length - 1;
    footer.style.setProperty("--progress", String((index + 1) * 100 / slides.length));
    announce.textContent = "Slide " + (index + 1) + " of " + slides.length + ". " + titleOf(active);
    if (shouldFocus) active.querySelector("h1,h2").focus({preventScroll:true});
    if (previous && previous !== active && window.matchMedia("(max-width:760px), (max-width:820px) and (orientation:portrait)").matches) window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:"instant"});
  }
  function go(index, moveFocus = false) {
    if (index < 0 || index >= slides.length) return;
    const target = "#" + slides[index].dataset.slide;
    if (location.hash === target) {
      render(moveFocus);
      return;
    }
    location.hash = target;
    render(moveFocus);
  }
  function showOverview() {
    if (!overview.open) {
      overview.showModal();
      links[current]?.focus();
    }
  }
  async function toggleFullscreen() {
    try {
      if (document.fullscreenElement) await document.exitFullscreen();
      else await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
    } catch (_) {
      announce.textContent = "Fullscreen is unavailable in this browser window.";
    }
  }
  prev.addEventListener("click", () => go(current - 1, true));
  next.addEventListener("click", () => go(current + 1, true));
  overviewButton.addEventListener("click", showOverview);
  fullscreen.addEventListener("click", toggleFullscreen);
  if (!document.fullscreenEnabled || !Element.prototype.requestFullscreen) fullscreen.hidden = true;
  document.addEventListener("fullscreenchange", () => {
    const active = Boolean(document.fullscreenElement);
    fullscreen.setAttribute("aria-pressed",String(active));
    fullscreen.querySelector("span").textContent = active ? "Exit fullscreen" : "Fullscreen";
  });
  window.addEventListener("hashchange", () => render());
  document.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
    if (event.defaultPrevented || event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey || event.altKey || overview.open) return;
    const key = event.key.toLowerCase();
    if (event.target instanceof HTMLElement && event.target.matches("input, textarea, select, [contenteditable], button, a") && key === " ") return;
    if (event.target instanceof HTMLElement && event.target.matches("input, textarea, select, [contenteditable]")) return;
    if (["arrowright", "pagedown", " "].includes(key)) {
      event.preventDefault(); go(current + (event.shiftKey && key === " " ? -1 : 1));
    } else if (["arrowleft", "pageup"].includes(key)) {
      event.preventDefault(); go(current - 1);
    } else if (key === "home" || key === "end") {
      event.preventDefault(); go(key === "home" ? 0 : slides.length - 1);
    } else if (key === "o") {
      event.preventDefault(); showOverview();
    } else if (key === "f" && !fullscreen.hidden) {
      event.preventDefault(); toggleFullscreen();
    }
  });
  deck.addEventListener("focusin", event => {
    if (event.target instanceof HTMLElement && event.target.closest("[aria-hidden=true]")) slides[current].querySelector("h1,h2").focus();
  });
  render();
})();
</script>
